title: Constructible restriction of finite-coefficient kernel recollement
statement:
Fix a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be separated of finite type over $k$, $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ its complementary open immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the small pro-etale sites and the coefficient categories $D^b_c(T,A_n)$ and $D^b_c(T,R)$ of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], for $T=X,Z,U$.
Fix $n\ge1$ and put $A=A_n$. On ordinary sheaves of $A$-modules define $i^!_0N=i^*\ker(N\to j_*j^*N)$, with derived functor computed on K-injective resolutions [lem-sf-ringed-closed-kernel-adjoint, def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Use the canonical finite operations of [def-weil-derived-direct-image, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The functor $Rj_*$ preserves $D^b_c$; the ambient $Ri^!_0$ restricts to a coefficient-linear exact right adjoint of $i_*$ on these full constructible categories. For every $M\in D(X_{\rm proet},A)$ the ordinary triangle $j_!j^*M\to M\to i_*i^*M\to$ induces, by the four adjunctions, for every $K\in D^b_c(X,A)$ a supported distinguished triangle $i_*Ri^!_0K\xrightarrow e K\xrightarrow u Rj_*j^*K\to$ whose first two maps are the actual counit and unit. Its ambient construction does not assume boundedness of $Ri^!_0K$. For every $P\in D^b_c(Z,A)$, $G\in D^b_c(U,A)$ and integer $m$, $\operatorname{Hom}(i_*P[m],Rj_*G)=0$.
The termwise closed counit $i^*i_*\to1$ with its signed shift comparison is invertible on bounded constructible complexes. All these conclusions use the intrinsic finite constructible categories, without replacing them by finite-Tor categories.

source.place: Finite stage and Vanishing; unit Hom(-,K) argument; returned proof steps 1–4

proof.text: The positive coefficient level is finite. The extension valuation identifies the maximal ideal with the uniformizer ideal; the prime belongs to it, so its (n+1)-st power kills A. This integer remains a unit in k. Finite type over the noetherian field makes X noetherian and the complementary open quasi-compact.

Apply the ringed closed-kernel adjunction with the constant coefficient ring. Transport closed and open inverse image along their canonical constant-coefficient identifications. The support kernel is in the closed essential image, so its closed unit is invertible. Maps from closed direct images factor uniquely through the open-unit kernel, defining the sheaf adjunction with precisely the normalized kernel counit. The intrinsic ambient theorem supplies right exactness of closed direct image.

Compare intrinsic inverse image with the transported fixed-module inverse image by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same direct image. Derive these exact comparisons. The published realization comparison for derived direct image identifies intrinsic closed and open direct image with fixed-module direct image. Uniqueness of right adjoints then identifies the specified derived kernel shriek with the transport of ProEtale.closedUpperShriek.rightDerivedFunctor. Its triangulated and additive instances are those of the canonical right derived functor. Transport the linear structures along the realization equivalences; fixed-module closed shriek is linear as right adjoint to a linear closed direct image, which proves preservation of the explicitly conjugated sfKernelScalar action.

For the ordinary triangle, complete the actual open-extension counit. Open restriction kills its cone because the open unit is invertible. Closed inverse image of the second arrow is invertible because closed inverse image kills extension by zero. The source-library fixed-coefficient closed essential-image theorem, transported by realization, makes the closed unit at the cone invertible. Its composite with the inverse of closed inverse image of the second arrow identifies the cone with i_*i^*M; naturality of the unit gives exactly the requested second map. Perform this construction for both intrinsic pullback and the canonically isomorphic constant-ring pullback. The latter ordinary triangle gives the closed essential image needed by Recollement.exists_distTriang_counit_unit, yielding the supported triangle with the actual exceptional counit and open unit. Recollement.subsingleton_hom_shift gives the stated vanishing. These constructions hold on all ambient objects before boundedness is used.

Intrinsic bounded constructibility is equivalent under derived realization to fixed-module bounded constructibility. Exact realization commutes with homology, finite homology support is equivalent to boundedness, and finite constructible homology sheaves descend to the etale site. Apply the existing source-library LocalizeConstructible theorems for fixed-coefficient pullback, closed direct image, open direct image and closed shriek. Their integer annihilator hypothesis is supplied by the first step. The comparison isomorphisms from the third step transport all four conclusions to precisely the functors in this statement; no Tor condition is introduced.

Full faithfulness of closed direct image, transported from the fixed-module derived functor, makes the actual exact-derived closed counit invertible. The standard exact-derived unit commutes with signed shifts, so the adjunction shift theorem gives the same compatibility for its counit. The localization-counit formula gives the displayed equality on every cochain complex with exactly the standard factorization isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: P8: canonical coefficient-realization transport of existing source-library finite-coefficient localization; ordinary-counit-cone construction precedes supported triangle; normalized exact closed counit retained.
